user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking by its ID so that I can see its details.

positive.title: Retrieve booking details successfully with valid ID
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
Step 2: Enter a valid booking ID
positive.expected_result: The booking details are displayed correctly on the screen.

negative.title: Error message displayed for non-existent booking ID
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
Step 2: Enter a non-existent booking ID
negative.expected_result: An error message is shown indicating that the booking ID does not exist.

edge.title: Handle retrieval with special characters in booking ID
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
Step 2: Enter a booking ID containing special characters
edge.expected_result: The system handles the input gracefully, either by sanitizing the input and attempting a valid retrieval or showing an appropriate error without crashing.
